主要内容: On September 20, 2012, Optical Cable Corporation (OCC) and BB&T Capital Markets executed an agreement to repurchase up to 320,000 shares of its common stock, representing approximately 4.9% of the current shares outstanding. The repurchase plan is expected to be executed over the next 12 to 24 months. The company's Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Tracy G. Smith, signed the report on behalf of the registrant. Neil Wilkin, President and Chief Executive Officer of OCC, stated that the share repurchase plan demonstrates the Board's confidence in the company's strategy and long-term prospects. The company has delivered strong earnings performance, driven by sales of fiber optic cable products, while maintaining a strong balance sheet and regular quarterly dividend. The repurchase program may be suspended, extended, or terminated at any time without prior notice.
